digo: Mkpwamba lungo; Mkambakamba (App. III); Mkpwamba, Chikwamba (App. VI)
digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III, V, VI and ch. 5

teaser.en: Seen as the 'male' of the white-berry bush, and known in English for smelling like boiled potatoes at dusk.
teaser.sw: Huonwa kama 'dume' wa kichaka cha matunda meupe, na kwa Kiingereza hujulikana kwa kunukia kama viazi vilivyochemshwa wakati wa magharibi.
teaser.dg: Adigo nkuuona dza 'mlume' wa *mkpwamba*, chitsaka cha matunda mereru; kpwa Chingereza unamanyikana kpwa sababu dziloni unalavya arufu dza ya viazi virivyookohwa.

summary.en: Mkpwamba lungo is a scrambling shrub with small leaves and black berries, seen by Digo speakers as the male counterpart of mkpwamba, the white-berry bush.
summary.sw: Mkpwamba lungo ni kichaka kinachotambaa chenye majani madogo na matunda meusi, ambacho Wadigo hukiona kama dume wa mkpwamba, kichaka cha matunda meupe.
summary.dg: *Mkpwamba lungo* ni chitsaka chinachoambala dzulu ya mimea yanjina, chenye makodza madide na matunda madide maru. Adigo nkuuona dza mlume wa *mkpwamba*, chitsaka cha matunda mereru.

about.en:
*Mkpwamba lungo* is a shrub, often scrambling or leaning on other plants, with slender, arching branches. The small oval leaves sit in two neat rows along the side shoots, so each shoot looks like a single feathery leaf. The flowers are tiny and reddish. They are followed by small round berries that turn dark purple to black, unlike the white berries of its 'female' counterpart.

In the evening the flowers give off a smell often compared to boiled potatoes, which is where the English name potato bush comes from. Pakia's informants identified it from its leaves.
about.sw:
*Mkpwamba lungo* ni kichaka, ambacho mara nyingi hutambaa au huegemea mimea mingine, chenye matawi membamba yaliyopinda kama tao. Majani madogo ya mviringo hukaa kwa safu mbili nadhifu kando ya vitawi vya pembeni, kwa hiyo kila kitawi huonekana kama jani moja lenye umbo la unyoya. Maua ni madogo sana na ya rangi ya wekundu. Baada yake huja matunda madogo ya mviringo yanayogeuka zambarau iliyokolea hadi meusi, tofauti na matunda meupe ya mwenzake wa 'kike'.

Jioni maua yake hutoa harufu ambayo mara nyingi hulinganishwa na ya viazi vilivyochemshwa; hapo ndipo jina la Kiingereza *potato bush* ('kichaka-viazi') lilipotoka. Watoa taarifa wa Pakia walikitambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg:
*Mkpwamba lungo* ni chitsaka, ambacho mara nyinji chinaambala au chinajejemera mimea yanjina, na china panda nyembamba zinazogbwadzika. Makodzage madide ga mviringo ganamera chila uphande wa panda ndide, hata chila panda ndide inaonekana dza kodza mwenga rinalofanana na linyoya. Maruwage ni madide sana na ga kundu. Chisha kunamera matunda madide ga mviringo ganayogaluka rangi kula zambarau hadi kukala maru, tafwauti na matunda mereru ga *mkpwamba*, ambao ni wa 'chichetu'.

Dziloni maruwa ganalavya arufu ambayo mara nyinji nkufananiswa na arufu ya viazi virivyookohwa, na ndiyo sababu kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *potato bush*. Atu ariomterya Pakia anaumanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It grows in thickets, along riverbanks and in wet bush, and is widespread in tropical Africa and Asia.
where.sw: Kinaota katika vichaka vizito, kando ya mito na katika vichaka vyenye unyevu, na kimeenea sana katika Afrika ya kitropiki na Asia.
where.dg: Unamera vitsakani, kanda-kanda ya miho na weruni phatu phenye madzi, na unaphahikana phatu phanji kpwenye tsi za dzoho za Afrika na Asia.

culture.en: Digo speakers pair it with *mkpwamba* (*Flueggea virosa*). Pakia explains that the 'female' *mkambavitu* is named for its fruits (*vitu*), which are white and easy to see, while this plant, the male, has less conspicuous fruits.
culture.sw: Wadigo hukiweka jozi moja na *mkpwamba* (*Flueggea virosa*). Pakia anaeleza kwamba *mkambavitu* wa 'kike' amepewa jina kutokana na matunda yake (*vitu*), ambayo ni meupe na huonekana kwa urahisi, ilhali mmea huu, ambao ni dume, una matunda yasiyoonekana kwa urahisi.
culture.dg: Adigo nkuuika phamwenga na *mkpwamba* (*Flueggea virosa*). Pakia anaeleza kukala *mkambavitu*, ambao ni wa 'chichetu', dzinare rinatuluka kpwa matundage (*vitu*), ambago ni mereru na ganaonekana upesi; ela uhu, ambao ni 'mlume', una matunda gasigoonekana upesi dza higo.

names.en: *Mkpwamba lungo* means 'basket *mkpwamba*'. Pakia records it as the male counterpart of *Flueggea virosa*, but says the link with *lungo*, a basket, is unclear. Pakia also lists the species under *mkambakamba*, *mkpwamba* and *chikwamba*, names he mainly uses for *Flueggea virosa*. Duruma shares the names. 'Potato bush' is a common English name for the species, but it is not given by Pakia.
names.sw: *Mkpwamba lungo* maana yake ni '*mkpwamba* wa kikapu'. Pakia anaandika kuwa ni dume wa *Flueggea virosa*, lakini anasema uhusiano wake na *lungo*, yaani kikapu, hauko wazi. Pakia pia anaorodhesha spishi hii chini ya *mkambakamba*, *mkpwamba* na *chikwamba*, majina ambayo kwa kiasi kikubwa anayatumia kwa *Flueggea virosa*. Kiduruma kinatumia majina hayo hayo. Kwa Kiingereza spishi hii huitwa kwa kawaida *potato bush*, lakini Pakia hatoi jina hilo.
names.dg: Dzina *mkpwamba lungo* rina mana ya '*mkpwamba* wa lungo'. Pakia anauandika dza mlume wa *Flueggea virosa*, ela anagomba kukala uhusiano wa dzina hiri na *lungo*, yani lungo ra kuphehera, taumanyikana. Pakia piya anaandika aina ihi photsi ya madzina *mkambakamba*, *mkpwamba* na *chikwamba*, madzina ambago sana sana anagahumira kpwa *Flueggea virosa*. Aduruma piya anahumira madzina higa. *Potato bush* ni dzina ra Chingereza rinalohumirwa sana kpwa aina ihi, ela Pakia kariandika.

reason.dg: *Flueggea virosa*, ambao ni wa 'chichetu' kpwa uhu
